caption: The drawing depicts a metallic service bell with a domed top, finished in shades of bronze and brown, mounted on an ornate, decorative metal base featuring floral or scrollwork-like motifs. The bell has a vertical post at its center, which supports the dome, and a curved lever or handle with a small rounded tip on one end, used to ring the bell. The entire bell structure is placed on a rectangular, light-colored stone or marble slab, depicted with subtle grey and beige tones. The background of the drawing is a plain, light cream color. The artist's signature, "Adele Brooks," is written in grey pencil or pastel on the lower right portion of the image.
title: Cast Iron Table Bell
